steps.name: Fragments of Memory (1)
steps.objective: Talk to [Atkina] in the "Dragon Valley", then obtain <Fragments of Memory> from monsters in the "Dragon Valley". Report to [Atkina] afterward.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Thank you for coming. I hope I'm not keeping you from your work.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right. I think I know a little of what you want to discuss...

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Do you? Then you already know. That expression of someone who has lost memories...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You explain that Shynic helped you with your lost memories.)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: She may grumble, but she gives everything to those she considers her own.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Indeed. Don't doubt it. I was going to mention the Tears of Light, too. Brew them into a drink, and there are almost no side effects.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh! You're not supposed to just swallow them?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: You swallowed them? Those potent things...?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: (Atkina looks sympathetic.)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Do you remember what I gave you for her before?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Memory Fragments?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Yes. Those fragments were entirely for her. But what I'm discussing now may serve your own memories.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lord Atkina, I haven't lost any memories from the Land of Illusions...

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Think of them as serving the same purpose as the Tears of Light. Surely you don't think I'll make you eat something dangerous again?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh! You won't?!

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I'll turn them into energy and pass it to you, so don't be afraid. Gather a suitable amount from the mythical beasts in Dragon Valley.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Then I'll purify them and infuse you with their energy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Lord Atkina! I'll be back!

steps.name: Fragments of Memory (2)
steps.objective: Complete the quest in front of the [Xenadia Statue] on "Orca Beach".

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Well done. I'll begin the purification.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: There. Finished.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What, already?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: It isn't a lengthy process. I hope my modest skill has helped you.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: The energy has already entered you. With a suitable trigger, your memories should soon return.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Lord Atkina! Oh, you seem to have something else to say.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Perceptive. There's something I'd like you to hear. Do you know Xenadia?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. I've visited... But I can't really remember what happened there.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: It seems you've lost memories connected to Xenadia. The reason I mention it is...

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: It's my homeland. Every Pluton dragon was born there.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: As you know from our private conversations, I once joined Goddess Seres in the battle against the Demon King.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Things did not go as hoped. I fell here and couldn't return home for a very long time. Then I learned the Demon King had vanished through Goddess Iris's efforts.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: And that the wall separating Freios and Jiendia had disappeared.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then you could visit Xenadia.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I have a duty to protect this land, given by Goddess Gaia... Even with her permission, I cannot leave my post.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: There's no one to replace me. Perhaps I need to train a successor.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What about Mir?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Hahaha! A fine joke. Visit Xenadia for me, who cannot leave, and for yourself as well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Xenadia...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What memories did I lose there?)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: What has you thinking so deeply?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, nothing. I'll go to Xenadia. What should I do?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Nothing difficult. Give my regards to the priests and Sisters. They'll know what to tell you.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Mir has often carried my messages. This time, please do it yourself.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will. Mir is busy enough. I'll make the trip.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Thank you. One question.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Go ahead.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Is there still a stone tower leading to Xenadia deep within Orca Beach?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. You can reach it that way.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Then offer a prayer to Goddess Seres when you arrive. That's all I ask. Once you're finished, return to your own duties.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will. I'll be going.

steps.name: Fragments of Memory (3)
steps.objective: Talk to [Priest Kratos] in the "Xenadia Surface Garden Healing Room".

lines.text: (Warm sunlight falls on Orca Beach.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This place is as mysterious as ever.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll pray before going on.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You bow before the stone tower and pray quietly, wishing, as always, for this world and Iris to remain safe.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A strange feeling suddenly comes over you.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What was that? My imagination?

lines.speaker: 누군가의 잔영
lines.text: (A faint afterimage appears before the tower. A delicate girl wearing a flower crown has a sacred air about her.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is this? An illusion? Who is she?

lines.speaker: 누군가의 잔영
lines.text: (The girl in the afterimage smiles softly.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who...? Could it be Goddess Seres?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The name Seres suddenly comes to mind.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course. I couldn't fail to recognize Goddess Seres. Then who is this...?

lines.speaker: 누군가의 잔영
lines.text: (At %s's murmuring, the girl smiles sadly and begins to speak. No voice can be heard.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: She's saying something, but I can't hear. Wait. Could you speak slowly, so I can read your lips?

lines.speaker: 누군가의 잔영
lines.text: (The girl nods and slowly opens her mouth, as %s asks.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: At... last... this... day... has... come... I... have... waited... for... you... for... so... long...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait, those words...? Why this sense of déjà vu?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Goddess Seres? Is it really you? I thought all your power had already passed to Iris...

lines.speaker: 누군가의 잔영
lines.text: (Still smiling, the girl struggles to continue.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello... I've... been... waiting... Was... the... journey... here... difficult? You're asking if it was hard?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, it wasn't. Coming all this way, I...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Suddenly, many memories begin to rise in %s's mind, along with subtle feelings whose source cannot be grasped.)

lines.speaker: 누군가의 잔영
lines.text: (With a sorrowful expression, the girl reaches out to stroke %s's head.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A-are you comforting me?

lines.speaker: 누군가의 잔영
lines.text: (The girl nods softly, then opens her mouth to speak again.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: My... name... is... Seres... In... the... age... when... the... first... stars... fell... on... Orca... Beach... I... sowed... the... seeds... of... life... and... song... across... the... world...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Goddess...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: W-wait. What did you say?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm... sorry... for... making... you... lose... your... memories? Wait... You're the reason I lost them?

lines.speaker: 세레스의 잔영
lines.text: (The girl who named herself Seres grows fainter until she can no longer be seen.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: She seemed to be trying to say something before disappearing...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: My head is a mess. Has something happened to me, too...? Why did I lose my memories...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris, if you can hear me, will you tell me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No answer again. It can't be helped. We can talk later... I came here for Lord Atkina's request first...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go to the priest I met before. He's the only priest in Xenadia I remember now.

steps.name: Fragments of Memory (4)
steps.objective: Go to [Priest Simurgh] in the "Xenadia Surface Garden Meditation Room".

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: Weren't you here in Xenadia recently? Has something happened?

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: Lost your memories again, perhaps...? Ah, you seem normal.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sorry for the late greeting. I had something on my mind. I haven't lost my memories.

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: What brings you here today? More potatoes and sweet potatoes for Mir, like last time?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. Lord Atkina sent me to give you his regards...

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: So my senior is well. How do you know him?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You tell Priest Kratos what happened in Adrica, in the Land of Illusions.)

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: Ah, Goddess Gaia has awakened. Has that time come already...? I thought I'd never hear that news in my lifetime.

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: He said the priests and Sisters would know what to do if you mentioned him? I haven't heard anything...

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: Wait. The Sisters? He must be mistaken.

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: Mir visits often, but doesn't discuss events in Freios. He probably doesn't know.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then who's the Sister here...? Sister Sistina is here...

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: There are no Sisters in Xenadia now. I don't know what you're talking about.

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: They received a revelation and went to the temple in Freios, then disappeared.

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: We lost contact when Lux, lord of the Demon Realm, attacked the temple and they rescued the children there.

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: Come to think of it, you...

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: So that's it. Now I understand. You haven't simply lost memories. You're standing at a distorted boundary of time and space, perhaps.

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: A kind of rift.

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: Did you see or feel anything else when you came here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I saw an afterimage of Lady Seres at the statue on Orca Beach.

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: Ah, Goddess...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's wrong?

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: As I said last time, time flows differently in Xenadia, as does the perception of space.

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: Perhaps her afterimage appeared to tell you something? At least, she is certainly worried...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why does this only happen to me in Xenadia? It won't lead to something terrible, will it?

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: I don't know. That's as much help as I can offer.

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: Sigh. Go to Simurgh in the Chamber of Meditation and speak only of Lord Atkina. He'll tell you what to do for him.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right...

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: I'm sorry. But I'm sure you'll discover the cause soon.

steps.name: Fragments of Memory (5)
steps.objective: Gather <Purifying Herbs> and <Moon Halo Herbs> in the "Xenadia Surface Garden Central Area". Then report to [Atkina] in the "Dragon Valley".

lines.speaker: 신관 시무르그
lines.text: Welcome, mortal. I felt a special star approaching, and here you are.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I've come from Adrica in Eastland to deliver Lord Atkina's regards.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You tell Priest Simurgh what happened in Adrica, in the Land of Illusions.)

lines.speaker: 신관 시무르그
lines.text: Goddess Gaia has awakened. Thank you for coming all this way amid so many events.

lines.speaker: 신관 시무르그
lines.text: When you next see my senior, please tell him we're well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will.

lines.speaker: 신관 시무르그
lines.text: Ah, where's my head? There was something I intended to send him... Mir was going to take it.

lines.speaker: 신관 시무르그
lines.text: But the child suddenly had work for Lady Iris, so it was delayed...

lines.speaker: 신관 시무르그
lines.text: He wanted plants found only in Xenadia to grow in Adrica, too. I gathered plenty...

lines.speaker: 신관 시무르그
lines.text: But there's a problem...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What problem?

lines.speaker: 신관 시무르그
lines.text: I gathered them, then forgot where I put them.

lines.speaker: 신관 시무르그
lines.text: ...This cursed forgetfulness.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I understand. You'd like me to find them.

lines.speaker: 신관 시무르그
lines.text: Who has time to search? Gathering fresh ones would be faster.

lines.speaker: 신관 시무르그
lines.text: Pick some Purification Grass and Moon Halo Grass and take them to Lord Atkina. They'll help cleanse the pollution where he lives.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where are they?

lines.speaker: 신관 시무르그
lines.text: Tucked away in the central area of the Aboveground Garden. A mortal like you will spot them easily. Gather plenty for my senior.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will. Farewell.

lines.speaker: 신관 시무르그
lines.text: And I hope you recover your lost memories.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you...

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I thought you'd go straight from Xenadia to other business. What brings you back to Dragon Valley?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The priests asked me to bring these plants.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You give Atkina the Purification Grass and Moon Halo Grass you gathered.)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: It's been so long. The scent of my homeland, Xenadia...

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: An unexpected gift. Thank you.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: (Atkina falls silent for a moment, lost in reflection.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mir was supposed to bring them, but suddenly had work for Iris, so it seems the delivery was delayed...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I brought them instead.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Ah, that child... Such a kind heart. I'll have to give my thanks. With food, of course.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: (A shadow crosses Atkina's face. Preparing enough food seems daunting. A moment later, his expression returns to normal.)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: The thought of growing these plants cheers me. Raised in sacred soil, they'll help reduce this land's pollution.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Goddess Gaia will be pleased, too.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I owe you again. How can I repay you...?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: But your expression suggests something happened in Xenadia. What was it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You tell Atkina what happened on Orca Beach.)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: What did you say? You saw Goddess Seres's afterimage?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: She passed all her remaining power to Lady Iris. Unless Goddess Iris wills it, Seres cannot appear in any form.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Yet if she appeared before you as an afterimage, there must be a definite reason.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: That reason seems connected to your memories. In any case, I'm glad your expression looks better.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Once Iris becomes a complete God of the Astral Realm, it will all be resolved. For now, she continues working toward it...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll wait. Perhaps an answer will turn up somewhere.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be going, Lord Atkina. May the Land of Illusions grow even more beautiful.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Thank you. I'll make it a land Goddess Gaia can look upon with satisfaction.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Already moving so easily through this dangerous valley... Truly remarkable.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Goddess Iris, you seem to be hiding something from that adventurer. What could it be...?
